definition: to spread make-up or colour until no edges show
description: A make-up studio with a bulb-lit mirror. A woman with a white towel wrapped round her hair sits with her eyes closed; separate stripes of skin-coloured cream have been dabbed on her forehead and cheeks. A hand dabs an orange sponge over them until the stripes disappear into her skin and the tone is even. A red-haired make-up artist then sweeps powder over her cheek with a brush, and in close-up paints her lips with a dark red lipstick. At the end the woman looks up with an even, finished face and red lips.

en.question: What is the make-up artist doing?
